Exercise: Front Cone Hops (or hurdle hops)

Category:
plyometrics

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- vertical_jump

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- abductors
- adductors
- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
1.5 hours

Goals:

- enhance_leg_muscle_strength_and_coordination
- improve_explosive_power

Contraindications:

- Recent lower body injury or surgery
- Chronic knee pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single Leg Hops, force: push, level: beginner, mechanic: unilateral, equipment: other

Substitution Options:

- name: Box Jumps, force: push, level: beginner, mechanic: compound, equipment: other

Instructions:

- Set up a row of cones or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart.
- Stand in front of the first cone with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
- Begin by jumping with both feet over the first cone, swinging both arms as you jump.
- Absorb the impact of landing by bending the knees, rebounding out of the first leap by jumping over the next cone.
- Continue until you have jumped over all of the cones.
